skill_name: Summarize the following text about dogs in 3-4 sentences.
workflow: Dogs are one of the oldest domesticated animals, having been bred from wolves for thousands of years. They are known for their loyalty, intelligence, and companionship towards humans. As a result, they have become a popular pet, guardian, and companion throughout human history. Dogs are seen as an integral part of many cultures and continue to be the most beloved animals around the world today.
